decisions.collectorChecklist: Keep all 800 numbered cards in one Base Product Set; #1-700 low series and #701-800 high series. Original high-series packs also contain low-series cards; VCS flattens availability for set completion.
decisions.rookies: 69 true base RCs: explicit canonical TCDB tags matched to its independently retrieved rookie index; 67 additionally labeled RC by Cardboard Connection. BCP omits seven RC labels; Cardboard Connection omits #538/#629. Exclude #514 Chuck Carr despite erroneous RC tags on two TCDB hologram variants: his recognized RC is 1990 Fleer Update U-34 (TCDB and Beckett). Subset titles alone do not confer RC status. Multi-player highlights and Michael Jordan SP1 are not true RCs.
decisions.printingVariations: One card per printed base number. TCDB BasicID=17 contains 802 rows: normalize 231b (corrected DH) and 636a (dated), omitting their alternate a/b rows. Other back-hologram stock differences (1990 baseball/Comic Ball, 1990-91 hockey, 1992 logo) and printing errors are manufacturing variations, not a verified complete commercially issued parallel checklist. Do not fabricate 800-card parallel sets from isolated variants. #309 is Milt Thompson, #311 Luis Salazar; BCP Other Variations prose transposes identities, while its actual checklist and TCDB/CCC agree.
decisions.physicalPack: Original standard foil: 15 cards plus one team-logo hologram; VCS total items=16, boxes=36 packs. oddsPerPack=1 guarantees one logo from a nonempty pool in src/app/api/rip/open/route.ts, leaving 15 regular/base slots before other insert replacements. Physical jumbo had 27 regular cards; no jumbo product is fabricated.
decisions.odds: VCS design assumption retained from draft: equal low/high channel mix, not a verified historical sales ratio. Ryan and Aaron Heroes historical 1:6 within their respective series become 1:12 each; combined SP1/SP2 stays 1:72. Logo stickers 1:1 foil. Silver Sluggers historical one per jumbo, unavailable in standard foil: no verified jumbo share, so replace unsupported 1:2 draft approximation with null. HH1 randomly inserted in high series; no established frequency. Autograph odds unknown. Null families remain collector checklists but cannot be pulled until Admin configures odds; pack/odds QA pending.
decisions.scarceHeaders: Heroes headers are SP. VCS chooses uniformly within a Product Set and cannot weight the header separately; retain unified collector checklists and document flattening. Product remains blocked from release pending pack QA.
decisions.eventExclusives: Heroes of Baseball H1-H4: one per specially marked low-series event box; H1-H3 autographs hand-numbered /3000. Retain genuine separate collector issues with null standard-product odds. H4 header depicts Killebrew/Perry/Jenkins, with three teams verified by TCDB; do not assign MLB.
decisions.excluded: 1991 Upper Deck Final Edition is a separate 100-card boxed release; other factory-only or promo materials are excluded. Magazine insert NNO is not treated as a trading card.
decisions.numberedLogos: 28 unnumbered logo cards (26 franchises plus AL and NL) receive deterministic collector IDs NNO-01..NNO-28 in alphabetical order; those IDs are VCS identifiers, not printed numbers.
decisions.safety: Offline regeneration validates every source row, 800-number coverage, identities against two independent base checklists, insert subjects/IDs, source team vocabulary, 69 true RCs and subset assignments before atomically writing 878 rows. --refresh-sources re-fetches and revalidates all sources; incomplete/changed data fails closed. --check compares committed CSV byte-for-byte. No database access from generator.
decisions.numTeamHeaders: Two generic Baseball Heroes NNO headers have no team affiliation. Leave blank, review.teamData PENDING, require --allow-pending-teams. Ten generic base checklists intentionally blank under importer exception. Player/team affiliations follow TCDB rows; AL/NL logo cards use explicit league subjects. No invented MLB teams.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: 800 printed numbers; 1–700 low, 701–800 high; one combined collector checklist.

productSets.name: Special Prints
productSets.notes: SP1 Michael Jordan (low series), SP2 Nolan Ryan / Rickey Henderson (high series), each 1:72 in its original pack channel.

productSets.name: Hank Aaron Hologram
productSets.notes: HH1 high-series insert. Published pack insertion rate not established; no invented odds.

productSets.name: Baseball Heroes - Nolan Ryan
productSets.notes: Cards 10–18 plus unnumbered SP header. Original 1:6 in low-series; normalized 1:12 across equal low/high mix.

productSets.name: Baseball Heroes - Hank Aaron
productSets.notes: Cards 19–27 plus unnumbered SP header. Original 1:6 in high-series; normalized 1:12 across equal low/high mix.

productSets.name: Silver Sluggers
productSets.notes: 18 SS-prefixed cards, one per physical jumbo; not standard foil. No verified jumbo-channel share: combined VCS odds deliberately null; Admin QA required.

productSets.name: Team Logo Holograms
productSets.notes: 26 franchise logos plus AL/NL logos; 1 per standard foil, 2 per jumbo according to TCDB (BCP general distribution says 1). Model standard foil guarantee only. NNO-01..28 are VCS IDs, not printed numbers.

productSets.name: Heroes of Baseball (Event)
productSets.notes: H1-H4, one per specially marked low-series event box, not normal retail foil. H4 depicts all three players; normal-product odds null.

productSets.name: Nolan Ryan Heroes Autograph
productSets.notes: Autographed #18, hand numbered to 2500; low series; unknown per-pack odds.

productSets.name: Hank Aaron Heroes Autograph
productSets.notes: Autographed #27, hand numbered to 2500; high series; unknown per-pack odds.

productSets.name: Heroes of Baseball Autographs (Event)
productSets.notes: H1–H3 autographed, each numbered to 3000; only in special event packs.
